description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents: local-first semantic search, dependency graphs, git history.
name: io.github.Contextual-Laboratories/contextual

environmentVariables.description: Python logging level as an integer (e.g. 10=DEBUG, 20=INFO). Defaults to INFO.
environmentVariables.name: CONTEXTUAL_LOG_LEVEL

packageArguments.description: Client name shown in this process's title (e.g. claude-code, cursor). Auto-detected if omitted.
packageArguments.name: --client

packageArguments.description: Explicit workspace path to index/serve. Omit to run in multi-workspace mode, where each tool call resolves its workspace automatically.
packageArguments.name: --workspace
